Taiwan Detects Chinese Military Presence

Taiwan detected one Chinese military aircraft and multiple Chinese naval vessels around its territory. The Tribune reported nine PLAN vessels, while The Economic Times stated 16 ships were detected. The incident involves the People's Liberation Army (PLA) and the People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN). The detection of Chinese military assets near Taiwan's territory is a significant development. The exact details of the incident, including the timing and location, are not specified in the reports.
